[issue by Atakku]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Describe the Issue

I am unable to functionally replicate this, but it keeps happening, seemingly randomly. One day it happened 5 times, the other it never happened. I am loosing my sanity here, and balm or amendments seem to be the only catch to what causes the game to loose all resources and eventually die.
